assets.name: woven-blue
assets.strategy: standalone transparent generation and bounded correction; technical alpha slicing only
assets.placement_rule: Uniformly fit full native rug width, align backEdgeAnchor to room source y~664; allow front to extend below viewport. Full-source aspect differs from front-cropped reference; do not stretch/squash/crop master.
deviations: Native width below requested 2x room-display master; preserve native pixels and assess final scene at actual size.
Initial full-rug 5.6 aspect assumption superseded by parent: approved comp crops frontedge. Full-item aspect is measured, composite placement pending.
One extra spacing-only cleanup separated accidentally touching upper objects; all4 complete outlines now pass shared slicer.
